title: Folder sizes in a tree
hints: Pattern: recursion over a tree. The size of a folder is the sum of its files plus the sizes of its subfolders, and "size of a subfolder" is the same question one level down.
Write a helper walk(node, path) that returns the total for node and stores it in a result dict; isinstance(value, dict) tells a folder from a file.
Build child paths as path.rstrip("/") + "/" + name so the root "/" does not produce "//Applications".
Create the result dict inside dir_sizes and pass it (or close over it); a mutable default argument like out={} is shared between calls.
